product_wide_rationale: Owns Concord development coordination and its separation from planning, repository review, merge, and predecessor evidence. CD-0213 amends planning and issue linkage. CD-0241 distinguishes eligible phase-local integration from main-branch review and merge evidence.
summary: priorities.md owns Concord's self-development route, including new managed assignments, in-flight outside-workflow work, and authorized defect repair. Linear MCP owns planning under CD-0213. Pull requests and required checks retain main-branch review and merge authority; CD-0241 defines eligible rapid-phase local integration evidence without waiving independent review.
title: Concord development coordination
